rules.title: MA Fair Housing Law: unlawful practices incl. source-of-income / voucher discrimination
rules.requirement: Landlords and others renting accommodations may not discriminate against applicants or tenants because they receive public assistance or a housing subsidy (such as a voucher), or because of a requirement of such a program. Section 4 also bars housing discrimination based on protected classes (e.g., race, sex, age, marital status, disability, children).
rules.quoted_span: to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of federal, state, or local public assistance, including medical assistance, or who is a tenant receiving federal, state, or local housing subsidies, including rental assistance or rental supplements
rules.effective_date_note: Document does not state an effective date for subsection 10.
rules.key_value: ban on discrimination based on public assistance / housing subsidy status
rules.exemptions: Subsections 7 and 11 exempt leasing a single unit in a two-family dwelling where the owner lives in the other unit; subsection 11 (children) has additional exemptions.

unverifiable_exemptions: elderly/infirm occupant exemption for dwellings of three or fewer apartments (subsection 11)

parsed.doc_summary: Official text of Massachusetts G.L. c. 151B, § 4 (unlawful discrimination practices). For the in-scope categories it supplies the screening-restriction rule: no discrimination in rental accommodations based on public assistance or housing subsidy recipiency (subsection 10), plus protected-class housing discrimination provisions. No effective date is stated in the document.
